description:
Goal
Preserve settled callable-boundary obligations when a returned suspend continuation must become a first-class runtime callable object during native lowering.

Problem being fixed
After fz-hwn.6, direct-only callables stay structural until some true runtime boundary demands materialization. The returned-suspend Enumerable/List reduce path still fails at that materialization point. Native tries to materialize a structural callable value in `main`'s clause body, but no settled boundary is published for it.

Verified failure
- `cargo test compiler2_abi_ready_keeps_returned_suspend_continuation_callable_entry --lib`
- `target/debug/fz2 --log-telemetry ... run <returned-suspend fixture>`
- Diagnostic: `compiler2 native lowering for root 0: native callable materialization for FunctionId(65)/0 has no settled callable boundary in Clause { owner: ExecutableKey { activation: ActivationKey { root: RootId(0), function: FunctionId(0), input: [] }, need: Value }, index: 0 }`

What we know
- This is not the old broad type-recovery bug.
- Native structural transport is already correct enough for direct-only flows.
- The failure occurs when a structural callable is intentionally materialized into `MakeFnRef` / `MakeClosure`, but the matching settled callable boundary is missing at that exact point.
- The follow-on fix must preserve the project rule: one place decides first-class callable materialization, and that same place publishes the settled boundary fact.

Design rule
- Structural direct callables remain structural until a real boundary demands a runtime callable object.
- The operation that materializes a callable object must also attach the settled native callable boundary. Materialization and boundary publication are one step.
- Do not re-introduce eager materialization at `FunctionRef` / `Lambda` step time.

Code seams
- `src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs`
- native callable boundary selection / materialization helpers
- native lowering of returned suspend continuation flows

Checks
- `cargo test compiler2_abi_ready_keeps_returned_suspend_continuation_callable_entry --lib`
- `target/debug/fz2 --log-telemetry ... run <returned-suspend fixture>` emits no native materialization-without-boundary diagnostic
- no direct-only path regresses back to eager first-class callable materialization
title: Compiler2 native returned suspend continuations lose settled callable boundaries
